summary: postinstall fetches and executes binary from hardcoded bare IP over TLS-disabled HTTPS
details: The package's postinstall script downloads a tarball from the hardcoded bare IP endpoint https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz with TLS certificate verification explicitly disabled (`rejectUnauthorized: false`). The archive is extracted into node_modules, the resulting binary is chmod 0755'd, and hardlinked into bin/.onecode where it is invoked as the package's CLI. There is no publisher-owned domain, no version pinning by hash, no signature verification, and TLS validation is turned off on the code-download path. Installing the package on default `npm install` causes an opaque native binary from an unverified network origin to be staged for execution on the installer's machine, and any on-path attacker can substitute arbitrary code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
